prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption consistently degraded performance across 2 tests and led to early stops.
Home wait-info updates (4 wins across 8 tests), adoption redesigns (2 wins across 5 tests), and finish redesigns (2 wins across 8 tests) yielded clear wins, though several tests in these categories showed no clear effect.
Choose-path layout changes (4 tests), choose-path copy (3 tests), sign-in hints (4 tests), sign-in notifications (4 tests), and sign-in copy (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect or degraded performance.
Kinds of change tested only once (such as adoption incentives, adoption notifications, or finish notifications) still provide thin evidence.
Predictions consistently underestimated large winning changes while overestimating changes that produced no clear effect or degraded performance.

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] waiting_screen_desktop_pet_preview_flow: Add an interactive pet preview component to the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: Home funnel step takes a long mean duration (2336s) and median (201s). Keeping users engaged reduces drop-off during rendering.)
1: [finish, new_screen] new_screen_pet_desktop_gestures: Insert a new screen at the end of onboarding detailing desktop pet gestures, hiding, and pet interaction controls. (why: Support mail highlights post-onboarding confusion: 'Unclear how to control, hide or talk to the pet' (3 emails).)
2: [finish, new_flow] home_intro_companion_setup_flow: Introduce a interactive desktop companion setup flow with a control checklist on home intro. (why: Finish stage median is 395s with drop-off at 89.3%. Guiding desktop readiness improves onboarding finish rate.)
3: [home, wait_info] waiting_render_system_status_notification: Enable desktop readiness notifications and precise time estimates during the render waiting screen. (why: Users spend an average of 2336s on the home/waiting stage. Explicit status notifications lower perceived wait friction.)
4: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_account_recovery_guide_hint: Add a prominent sign-in hint explaining how signing into an existing account restores pets. (why: Support mail reported 8 issues where pets were missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [adoption, hint] upload_photos_error_recovery_hint: Display explicit photo quality and framing guidance hints on the upload photos screen. (why: Support emails show 3 cases of 'Making a custom pet fails or the result looks wrong'.)
6: [home, notification] waiting_pet_care_tips_notification: Add key feature highlight badges to the waiting screen explaining basic desktop pet interaction tips. (why: Pre-educates users during the long render wait (median 201s), resolving post-onboarding confusion before it happens.)
7: [finish, copy] home_intro_desktop_controls_copy: Update home_intro headline and body copy to clearly describe desktop controls and interaction methods. (why: Addresses support complaints regarding how to hide, summon, and talk to pets after onboarding.)
